title: Career Roadmap · Fashion Assistant
summary: A Fashion Assistant supports designers and apparel teams with garment preparation, fabric and trim selection, sample development, trend research, fittings, styling and production coordination.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Fabric types, colour theory, fashion terminology and garment construction.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Core skills
blocks.text: Fashion illustration, stitching, pattern basics, sample preparation and styling.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Advanced skills
blocks.text: Trend research, fabric/trim selection, fittings, design software and production coordination.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Create a portfolio, document design references and assist with a sample collection.

blocks.text: Create a mood board • Assemble a fabric-and-trim swatch book • Prepare a garment sample • Develop a mini seasonal collection concept.

blocks.label: Core skills
blocks.text: Fabric knowledge, garment construction, colour coordination, trend research, visual presentation, teamwork and organization.

blocks.label: Tools / technologies
blocks.text: Sketchbooks, sewing equipment, digital mood-board tools, Adobe Illustrator or equivalent design software, and spreadsheets for sample tracking.
Useful credentials

items.text: DGT / NCVT-recognized Fashion Design & Technology or related trade certificate.
CAD / digital fashion illustration training.
Pattern-making and garment-construction courses.
Styling or visual-merchandising training relevant to the target role.

blocks.text: A strong portfolio and practical garment knowledge are important; certificates do not guarantee employment.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: Italy, UK, Canada, Australia and Germany.
Institutions to research

items.text: Politecnico di Milano — Italy; fashion-design programs.

TAFE providers — Australia; fashion and apparel courses.
German universities of applied sciences — textile, clothing and fashion-related programs.

blocks.text: These are research starting points; verify current program availability, international admission eligibility and tuition on official websites.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic transcripts, language proficiency where applicable, course-specific prerequisites and a portfolio for some design programs.

blocks.label: Roles
blocks.text: Fashion Assistant, Design Assistant, Styling Assistant, Sample Development Assistant and Apparel Production Assistant.

blocks.label: Industries
blocks.text: Fashion brands, apparel manufacturing, retail, e-commerce, costume and garment exports.
